functional_semantics: Users act outside their intended permissions - IDOR, missing function-level authorization, privilege escalation, force-browsing to unauthorized resources.
root_cause: Users act outside their intended permissions - IDOR, missing function-level authorization, privilege escalation, force-browsing to unauthorized resources.
fix_pattern: Deny by default; enforce authorization server-side on EVERY request; check record ownership; centralize access-control logic; never rely on client-side enforcement or hidden fields.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Broken Access Control.

functional_semantics: Insecure defaults, unnecessary features, verbose errors, open cloud storage, unpatched or default-credential components.
root_cause: Insecure defaults, unnecessary features, verbose errors, open cloud storage, unpatched or default-credential components.
fix_pattern: Harden a repeatable baseline; disable unused features/defaults; suppress verbose errors in prod; review cloud/IAM configs; scan configuration automatically.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Security Misconfiguration.

functional_semantics: Vulnerable, outdated, or compromised components and a compromised build/CI pipeline (expanded from 2021's Vulnerable & Outdated Components).
root_cause: Vulnerable, outdated, or compromised components and a compromised build/CI pipeline (expanded from 2021's Vulnerable & Outdated Components).
fix_pattern: Maintain an SBOM; pin and verify dependencies; sign build artifacts; monitor advisories (OSV/GHSA); secure the CI/CD pipeline and its secrets.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Software Supply Chain Failures.

functional_semantics: Weak or missing cryptography exposes data in transit or at rest; plaintext secrets; weak hashes.
root_cause: Weak or missing cryptography exposes data in transit or at rest; plaintext secrets; weak hashes.
fix_pattern: TLS everywhere; strong, current algorithms; proper key management/rotation; hash passwords with argon2/bcrypt/scrypt; never hardcode secrets.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Cryptographic Failures.

functional_semantics: Untrusted input is interpreted as code or query - SQL injection (CWE-89), XSS (CWE-79), OS/command/code injection, and (2025) SSRF folded in.
root_cause: Untrusted input is interpreted as code or query - SQL injection (CWE-89), XSS (CWE-79), OS/command/code injection, and (2025) SSRF folded in.
fix_pattern: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements; context-aware output encoding; allow-list input validation; safe APIs/ORM; avoid shells and eval.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Injection.

functional_semantics: Missing or ineffective security controls by design - business-logic flaws that no amount of clean implementation fixes.
root_cause: Missing or ineffective security controls by design - business-logic flaws that no amount of clean implementation fixes.
fix_pattern: Threat-model early; apply secure design patterns; write security requirements and abuse cases; design for least privilege and secure defaults.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Insecure Design.

functional_semantics: Weak authentication, credential stuffing, brittle session management, default credentials.
root_cause: Weak authentication, credential stuffing, brittle session management, default credentials.
fix_pattern: Require MFA; rate-limit and lock out brute force; strong session management (rotation, secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookies); secure credential storage.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Authentication Failures.

technique: A08 Software or Data Integrity Failures
functional_semantics: Unsigned or untrusted updates, insecure deserialization (CWE-502), and CI/CD integrity failures.
root_cause: Unsigned or untrusted updates, insecure deserialization (CWE-502), and CI/CD integrity failures.
fix_pattern: Verify signatures/integrity of code and data; avoid native deserialization of untrusted data; use trusted repositories and integrity checks.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Software or Data Integrity Failures.

technique: A09 Security Logging and Alerting Failures
functional_semantics: Insufficient logging, monitoring, and alerting to detect and respond to attacks in time.
root_cause: Insufficient logging, monitoring, and alerting to detect and respond to attacks in time.
fix_pattern: Log security-relevant events with context; centralize and monitor; alert on anomalies; protect log integrity; define an incident-response path.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Security Logging and Alerting Failures.

functional_semantics: Improper handling of errors/exceptions leaks information or fails open (NEW in 2025).
root_cause: Improper handling of errors/exceptions leaks information or fails open (NEW in 2025).
fix_pattern: Fail securely (closed); return generic error messages; handle all exceptional paths; never leak stack traces or sensitive data in errors.
detection_hint: Application-layer weakness in the class Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions.

functional_semantics: User input is rendered into HTML/JS without neutralization, so it executes in a victim's browser.
root_cause: User input is rendered into HTML/JS without neutralization, so it executes in a victim's browser.
fix_pattern: Context-aware output encoding at every sink; a strict Content-Security-Policy; framework auto-escaping; sanitize rich text with a vetted library.
detection_hint: User-controlled data reflected or stored into HTML/attribute/JS/URL contexts without encoding.

functional_semantics: Untrusted input is concatenated into a SQL statement and interpreted as query structure.
root_cause: Untrusted input is concatenated into a SQL statement and interpreted as query structure.
fix_pattern: Parameterized queries / prepared statements everywhere; ORM with bound params; least-privilege DB accounts; allow-list any dynamic identifiers.
detection_hint: SQL built by string concatenation/format with request data.

functional_semantics: A state-changing request is accepted without proof it was intentionally issued by the authenticated user.
root_cause: A state-changing request is accepted without proof it was intentionally issued by the authenticated user.
fix_pattern: Synchronizer (anti-CSRF) tokens on state-changing requests; SameSite cookies; re-auth for sensitive actions.
detection_hint: State-changing POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints lacking a CSRF token or SameSite protection.

functional_semantics: A function or resource performs no authorization check, so any authenticated (or anonymous) actor can reach it.
root_cause: A function or resource performs no authorization check, so any authenticated (or anonymous) actor can reach it.
fix_pattern: Enforce authorization server-side on every request; deny by default; centralize the check so no handler can forget it.
detection_hint: Endpoints/handlers/resources with no permission check before the action.

functional_semantics: User input is used to build a filesystem path, letting '../' escape the intended directory.
root_cause: User input is used to build a filesystem path, letting '../' escape the intended directory.
fix_pattern: Canonicalize then confine to a base directory; allow-list filenames; reject traversal sequences; use safe file APIs.
detection_hint: File open/read/write using a user-controlled path component.

functional_semantics: Untrusted input is passed into an OS shell command.
root_cause: Untrusted input is passed into an OS shell command.
fix_pattern: Avoid the shell; use exec with an argument array and no shell interpretation; allow-list arguments; never interpolate input into a command string.
detection_hint: system()/exec()/popen/backticks built with request data.

functional_semantics: Untrusted input is evaluated as program code.
root_cause: Untrusted input is evaluated as program code.
fix_pattern: Never eval untrusted input; remove dynamic code execution; if unavoidable, sandbox with a strict allow-list.
detection_hint: eval/exec/Function()/template code paths fed user data.

technique: CWE-434 Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type
functional_semantics: Uploaded files are not validated, allowing executable or malicious content into a served/executed location.
root_cause: Uploaded files are not validated, allowing executable or malicious content into a served/executed location.
fix_pattern: Validate type/size/content (not just extension); store outside the web root; serve with no-execute; randomize names; scan content.
detection_hint: Upload handlers without type/content validation or storing under the web root.

functional_semantics: Attacker-controlled serialized data is deserialized into objects, enabling gadget-chain code execution.
root_cause: Attacker-controlled serialized data is deserialized into objects, enabling gadget-chain code execution.
fix_pattern: Do not natively deserialize untrusted data; use data-only formats (JSON) with schema validation; sign/verify integrity if serialization is required.
detection_hint: pickle.loads / ObjectInputStream / unserialize / yaml.load on request data.

functional_semantics: An authorization check exists but its logic is flawed, granting access it should deny.
root_cause: An authorization check exists but its logic is flawed, granting access it should deny.
fix_pattern: Centralize and unit-test authorization; deny by default; verify against a policy, not ad-hoc conditionals.
detection_hint: Authorization conditionals with logic errors (wrong role/ownership comparison).

functional_semantics: Access control is missing or improperly enforced for a resource or action.
root_cause: Access control is missing or improperly enforced for a resource or action.
fix_pattern: Enforce least privilege server-side; deny by default; consistent access-control layer across all entry points.
detection_hint: Resources/actions reachable without an enforced access-control decision.

functional_semantics: Sensitive data is disclosed to actors not authorized to see it.
root_cause: Sensitive data is disclosed to actors not authorized to see it.
fix_pattern: Minimize collected/returned data; authorize before returning; redact in logs/errors; encrypt at rest and in transit.
detection_hint: Sensitive fields in responses, error messages, or logs without authorization.

technique: CWE-306 Missing Authentication for Critical Function
functional_semantics: A critical function is reachable without any authentication.
root_cause: A critical function is reachable without any authentication.
fix_pattern: Require authentication on all sensitive operations; no unauthenticated admin/management endpoints.
detection_hint: Critical/admin endpoints with no authentication requirement.

functional_semantics: The server fetches an attacker-controlled URL, reaching internal services or metadata endpoints.
root_cause: The server fetches an attacker-controlled URL, reaching internal services or metadata endpoints.
fix_pattern: Allow-list outbound destinations; block internal/link-local ranges and cloud metadata IPs; resolve+validate the host; no raw user-URL fetches.
detection_hint: Server-side HTTP/file fetch of a user-supplied URL/host.

functional_semantics: Untrusted input is incorporated into a command that a component executes.
root_cause: Untrusted input is incorporated into a command that a component executes.
fix_pattern: Use parameterized/allow-listed command APIs; avoid shells; separate command from data.
detection_hint: Command strings assembled with request data.

technique: CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key (IDOR)
functional_semantics: Object references (ids) are honored without checking the caller owns/may access that object.
root_cause: Object references (ids) are honored without checking the caller owns/may access that object.
fix_pattern: Enforce per-object ownership/authorization on every reference; use unguessable or indirect references; never trust a client-supplied id alone.
detection_hint: Resource access by a user-supplied id with no ownership check.

functional_semantics: Input is used without adequate validation of type, length, format, or range, enabling downstream injection/logic abuse.
root_cause: Input is used without adequate validation of type, length, format, or range, enabling downstream injection/logic abuse.
fix_pattern: Allow-list validation at trust boundaries; canonicalize before validating; reject rather than sanitize where possible.
detection_hint: Request data used in a sink without prior validation.
